UNDERSTAND A SECURITY NOTIFICATION

A signal is a question.
Evidence comes first.

If you receive a message claiming to be from Cyber Defender, take time to verify it independently. A notification is not proof that your business has been compromised.

What a responsible notice should explain

  • The public observation, its date and why it may be relevant.
  • What was and was not checked, including attribution and uncertainty.
  • A safe route to ask questions, without asking for credentials or payment.

Verify before you act

Type our website address into your browser independently. Do not share passwords, authentication codes, customer records or recovery information. A message or link does not establish domain ownership and must never grant access to private reports.

Our current status

Cyber Defender’s AI-assisted discovery, automated notification and private portal are planned, not operational. We have no live scanning engine or customer login on this website. If a message claims otherwise, do not rely on it.

A clear next step

Review our sample report and proposed prices, then use the assessment preparation page to understand the intended scoping process. Our booking calendar and direct business contact are not yet connected; this page cannot accept a report or enquiry. No payment is required to read this information.
